name: 11Sight
description_en:
11Sight’s current homepage emphasizes AI agents for customer-facing operations and call centers, particularly automotive service appointments. Its older inbound-video model remains described on the public pricing page as e-lines and e-rooms. These are related product surfaces, but they cannot be merged into one assumed package.

The current Service Agent describes booking, checking, rescheduling and canceling appointments, plus escalation to people. This profile distinguishes documented actions from marketing claims about call resolution, revenue and saved labor; none of those outcomes were independently measured.
description_zh:
11Sight 当前首页重点介绍客户运营及呼叫中心 AI 代理，尤其汽车售后预约。公开定价页仍介绍较早的 e-line、e-room 入站视频模式。它们是相关产品页面，但不能混成一个假定套餐。

当前 Service Agent 描述预约、查询、改期、取消及转人工。本文区分文档中的动作与电话解决率、营收及节省人力等营销主张，未独立测量这些结果。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: reschedule a vehicle service visit
sections.title_zh: 示例：调整车辆保养预约
sections.en:
A caller can ask the Service Agent about a scheduled visit, supply identifying details and request a different time. The vendor describes integrations and appointment actions, but a business must establish which system owns the appointment and which callers may alter it. A conversational answer is not proof that a booking record changed.

Evaluate a successful reschedule, an ambiguous caller identity and an unavailable destination system. Compare the actual appointment and the human handoff context. This is a suggested test, not a live call performed for this profile; no demo form was submitted.
sections.zh:
来电者可以向 Service Agent 询问已有到访、提供识别信息并请求改期。厂商介绍集成及预约动作，但业务必须确定哪个系统拥有预约、哪些来电者可修改。对话答复不能证明预约记录已变化。

建议评估成功改期、来电身份模糊及目标系统不可用，对照实际预约及转人工背景。这是建议测试，本文未实际拨打，也未提交演示表单。

sections.title_en: Ask for an agent quote, not an inherited video price
sections.title_zh: 代理应询价，不能沿用视频价格
sections.en:
The current homepage directs buyers to contact the company for pricing. The public pricing page instead labels an inbound-video offering and contains conflicting seat totals, per-seat figures and fourteen- versus thirty-day trial messages. None reliably establishes the price of the present automotive voice agent. Accordingly no normalized monthly amount is supplied.

A quote should state the agent types, sites, phone numbers, call or minute metering, integrations, recordings, escalation and support. Ask how unanswered, failed and transferred calls count. Do not infer unlimited AI usage from an older e-room Enterprise statement.
sections.zh:
当前首页要求联系厂商询价，公开定价页却标为入站视频方案，并存在席位总额、每席位金额及十四/三十天试用的矛盾。这些不能可靠证明当前汽车语音代理价格，因此本文不提供归一月费。

报价应写明代理类型、站点、号码、通话或分钟计量、集成、录音、转人工及支持。应询问未接通、失败及已转人工的通话如何计数，不能从旧 e-room Enterprise 的措辞推定 AI 用量不限。

sections.title_en: AI operations require an accountable booking owner
sections.title_zh: AI 运营需要明确预约责任人
sections.en:
Automotive service and customer operations teams can evaluate the current agent workflow. A buyer seeking a conventional general-purpose video meeting room should specifically verify the continuing e-line/e-room offer and its terms. Existing category placement is retained as catalogue history, not proof that the homepage still has the old emphasis.

Prepare business hours, authorized actions, customer fields, escalation destinations and recording policy. The read pages do not establish universal identity checks, fault recovery or an open-source/self-hosted distribution. Test ambiguous requests and downstream failures before allowing production changes; no accuracy, latency, privacy or integration test was run here.
sections.zh:
汽车售后及客户运营团队可评估当前代理流程。寻找通用视频会议室的买家，应单独确认 e-line/e-room 是否继续提供及具体条款。目录原分类作为历史保留，不证明首页重点仍与旧稿相同。

准备营业时间、允许动作、客户字段、升级目的地及录音政策。已读页面未证明通用身份校验、故障恢复或开源/自托管发行版。开放生产修改前应测试模糊请求与下游失败；本文未测试准确性、延迟、隐私或集成。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Current AI call/minute metering, integrations, identity controls, recordings, data terms and legacy video availability need a vendor quote and account test.
research_gaps.zh: 当前 AI 通话/分钟计量、集成、身份控制、录音、数据条款及旧视频可用性需报价与账户测试。

research_gaps.en: Public pricing page has conflicting seat amounts and trial lengths; no performance or live call was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 公开定价页席位金额与试用期矛盾，未实测性能或通话。
